column1: # These files are NOT stored in this repository. Run `scripts/fetch-corpus.sh`
# to download them into `testdata/corpus/<source>/` (git-ignored). Every file is
# pinned to an upstream commit (see the script) and verified by SHA-256.
#   tika      Apache Tika test documents          Apache-2.0
#   poi       Apache POI test data (diagram/)     Apache-2.0
#   tika-pdf  Apache Tika PDF test documents      Apache-2.0
#   pdfjs     Mozilla pdf.js test files           Apache-2.0
